The '''Plant Operations Division''' was a division of the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] that was based at the [[Maw Installation]], an [[Imperial research center]] in the midst of the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]], a virtually unnavigable cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]]. The Plant Operations Division was headed by [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Wermyn]].<ref name="CotF" />
